Frequently asked questions

Questions? We’re here to listen.

Find a few quick answers before taking the next step.

Ask us a question
What kind of NDIS support can I enquire about?

You can ask about support coordination, respite, behaviour support, in-home care, community participation, supported accommodation, transport and older persons mental health services. We can discuss your goals and which services may be appropriate.

Can a family member or support coordinator contact you?

Yes. Participants, family members, carers and professional referrers can all get in touch to discuss a potential support arrangement.

Where does Yuvan Care Provider offer support?

Yuvan Care Provider supports participants across Sydney, including Penrith and Western Sydney. Availability for a particular suburb or service should be confirmed directly with the team.

What should I prepare before enquiring?

A brief description of your goals, the type of support you are seeking and any NDIS plan information you are comfortable sharing can help the initial conversation.
